approachQuestion.prompt: Return the smallest integer contained anywhere in a value, or NONE if it contains no integers. NONE is a separate tag, not an integer. Examples: [[],[8,-2],5] returns -2; [[],[]] returns NONE; 0 returns 0.
constraints: A value is either a signed 32-bit integer or an ordered list of values; lists may be empty.
The input is finite, acyclic, and has no shared subobjects. There are n total integer and list objects, including the root, with 1 ≤ n ≤ 100000; maximum nesting depth is h ≤ 1000.
Do not modify the input. Indexing a list, reading a tag, and integer comparisons take constant time.

options.text: Return NONE as soon as any child list contains no integers.
options.feedback: For [[],3], the empty child must not erase the valid candidate 3.

options.text: Return an integer leaf as a present minimum. For a list, begin with NONE and combine only present child minima, retaining the smaller value.
options.feedback: An empty region contributes absence rather than an invented candidate, and every actual integer can win.

options.text: Collect all integers into an array, then find its minimum; return NONE when the array is empty.
options.feedback: This is correct, but materializing every integer uses removable storage; a minimum summary suffices.

options.text: Begin every list minimum at zero and replace it only with smaller child results.
options.feedback: For [4,7], zero is returned even though it is absent from the input.

feedback.reason: An empty nested structure has no minimum, not numeric zero.
details: Return (present,value) from each call. An integer returns itself as present. A list loops through its children and updates one optional minimum using each child result; a list with no present result returns NONE.
An empty nested structure has no minimum, not numeric zero. Carry a presence tag so negative and positive values are compared only with real candidate integers. Fold children one at a time.

complexityQuestion.prompt: Analyze method-1 as described in the revealed method. Let n and h have the meanings in Q1. Use child indices and references without copying lists. Count active call frames; exclude input and returned output. There is no tail-call elimination. No hashing is used. Choose the tightest worst-case time and auxiliary-space pair among the options.

feedback.reason: Each object contributes one optional-minimum combine with depth-sized frames.
details: All objects may need inspection. Each frame retains only an optional minimum and its child cursor, so peak storage follows the active nesting path.
“O(n) time, O(1) auxiliary space”: Nested calls remain active along a path; their storage must be counted.
“O(n²) time, O(h + 1) auxiliary space”: Each object is processed once without rescanning or copying its descendants.
“O(h + 1) time, O(h + 1) auxiliary space”: A shallow but wide input can still require inspecting every object.
